question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct option is:** stretched out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that the same voice that made everything come to life at once also pulled them into a deeper, otherwise hidden world that seemed to go on forever.
 
• The phrase **"stretched out" (कार्यग्रस्त)** fits the blank because it conveys the idea of extending into a vast or boundless space, which is appropriate for describing something "into eternity."
 
• It suggests the infinite reach or the limitless nature of the world that the voice is unveiling.
 
• **"Stretched out"** aligns with the context of something extending beyond the present moment, into eternity, as the passage describes the voice drawing the listeners into a deeper world.

Hence, the correct answer is: stretched out.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Handed over (सोपना देना): **This means to give or transfer something to someone else. It doesn't fit here because it doesn't convey the idea of something extending or reaching into eternity.
 
• **Pleaded for (बिनती करना):** This means to request or ask for something earnestly. It doesn't align with the concept of eternity or an infinite world.
 
• **Asked for (मांगना):** This means to make a request or demand. It doesn't fit the context of extending into an infinite or boundless realm.
